entities.summary: The Odesa National University of Technologies (ONTU) is a public university with the highest level of accreditation. It was established in 1902 and today is a modern innovative scientific center for training of high qualified personnel. ONTU is a multi-profile HEI which includes 4 scientific-educational institutions, 11 faculties and research institute with 15 scientific schools. ONTU has about 6500 students in 21 areas of training, 42 training programs, 10 doctorate and 3 post-doctorate programs, 4 specialized scientific councils for doctorate and post-doctorate theses defense.
